data.description: Points: { key, label, axisLabel?, values }. values maps series keys to numbers; a missing value counts as zero.

series.description: Lines: { key, label, color?, dashed?, area? }. area defaults to true for the first series.

label.description: What is measured, such as "Signups". Names the chart for assistive technology.

unit.description: Unit after each value in the tooltip and table, such as "ms".

height.description: Plot height in pixels. The width follows the container.

formatValue.description: Formats values in the tooltip and data table. Defaults to grouped numbers with one decimal.

formatTick.description: Formats the value axis, such as 1.2K.

defaultHiddenSeries.description: Hidden series keys on first render when uncontrolled.

onHiddenSeriesChange.description: Called when a legend toggle changes the hidden keys.

onActiveChange.description: Called as the crosshair moves, and with null when it leaves. Use it to drive a headline readout.

loading.description: Dims the current lines while the next range loads, or shows a skeleton when there is no data.

emptyLabel.description: Shown when there are no points.

legend.description: Series toggles above the plot. Shown by default when there is more than one series.

categoryLabel.description: Header of the first column in the screen reader table, and part of the plot's slider label.

curve.description: Monotone curves that never swing past the data, or straight segments.
